newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Teva gets FDA generic drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Teva gets FDA generic drug approval.

text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it has received approval from the U.S. Food & Drug Administration to make and market Captopril and Hydrochlorothiazide tablets.
The drug is a generic version of Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's Capozide, a treatment for high blood pressure with annual sales of $40 million.
The FDA's approval will take effect with the expiration of Capozide's patent on December 27, 1997. Teva said another company has a similar generic drug approval.
Teva is Israel's largest pharmaceuticals company.
